title: Tesla: Making electric cars exciting, and then affordable
text: Before Tesla, electric cars were seen as slow, short-range and boring. Big car makers were not betting on them.

title: NVIDIA: From graphics chips to AI computing
text: Graphics chips were used mainly for games.

title: SpaceX: Making rockets reusable and space cheaper
text: Rockets were thrown away after one flight, like throwing away a jet after one trip. That made space very costly.

title: Netflix: From DVDs by mail to streaming
text: Renting movies meant going to a store and paying late fees.

title: Amazon Web Services: Selling computing power as a service
text: Starting a website or app meant buying and running your own servers.

title: Meta: From a college website to a family of apps
text: People wanted an easy, always-on way to stay in touch with friends, family and communities.

title: Google: Organising the world's information
text: In the 1990s the web was growing fast but finding good pages was slow and the results were often poor.

title: OpenAI: Bringing AI chat to everyone
text: Strong AI research stayed mostly with experts. Ordinary people had no easy way to try it.

title: Reliance Jio: Making mobile internet cheap in India
text: Mobile data in India was costly and slow. Many people could not afford to use the internet much.

title: WhatsApp: Simple messaging for everyone
text: Texting by SMS cost money and worked differently across countries.
